name: Empowered Sanguine Mend carries a player instant-cast modifier while Empowered is up (#12157)
contract: Pooled Vitality 681078 lets a Rage spell consume ten Pooled Vitality 680687 stacks to become empowered; the
Sanguine Mend description reads 'Empowered: Becomes instant cast and heals yourself for $680033s1% of the heal
value'. The server zeroed the empowered cast's own cast time inside Player::ApplySpellMod, but the player held
no spell modifier, so the client, which applies only the SMSG_SET_PCT_SPELL_MODIFIER totals Player::AddSpellMod
sends, still saw CastingTimeIndex 19 (2500 ms) and refused the instant cast while moving (#12157).
Sanguine Mend (Empowered) 680033 effect 1 is that modifier: aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10
(SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -101 with DieSides 1 (-100%) and EffectSpellClassMask (524288, 0, 0), the
nine Sanguine Mend ranks. The Empowered indicator 524899 exists exactly while ten stacks can empower a cast
(bloodmage-pooled-vitality-empowered-glow-8454), so it carries that modifier. spell_cast_time_ms is the
native cast time without a Spell, i.e. only the player's spell modifiers, the same totals the client is sent.
Expected: 2500 ms at nine stacks, 0 at ten stacks, an empowered Mend cast while moving succeeds and spends
the stacks, and the modifier leaves with Empowered so the next Mend is 2500 ms again. Packet delivery and the
client's own movement check are outside the runner's coverage.
